intent: Hold the transcript's messages as a log whose additions the scroller watches to follow, anchor or preserve the reading position.
typical_uses: The list of MessageScrollerItems inside a MessageScrollerViewport

dont_use_when.situation: The layout of one message, its avatar, side and header

invariants.text: The content renders with `role="log"` and `aria-relevant="additions"`, each replaced when the consumer passes its own.

The scroller counts every direct child except its own spacer as a message when it decides whether content was appended or prepended; only a MessageScrollerItem carries the `messageId` and `scrollAnchor` that anchoring, visibility and `scrollToMessage` read.

After its children the content renders one `aria-hidden` spacer (`data-message-scroller-spacer`, class `spacerClassName`), hidden at zero height, that the scroller sizes to make an alignment to the top reachable; scrolling to the end or the start collapses it to zero.

When at least one direct child carries `data-scroll-anchor`, which every MessageScrollerItem renders, message-scroller.module.css packs the children to the end of the content box, so a transcript shorter than the viewport sits at its bottom; without such a child the content flows from the top.

a11y.by: message-scroller.test.tsx finds the content with getByRole('log'); the primitive's Content supplies the role and aria-relevant

bad.title: The jump button placed inside the content
bad.why: The button then counts as a message in the scroller's bookkeeping: it is taken for an appended item and its box enters the content-height measurement. It belongs directly inside MessageScroller, positioned over the viewport.
